records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and six months ended June 30, 2022, we generated $191.9 million and $370.9 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended June 30, 2022 was: cloud subscriptions 22%; software license 3%; maintenance 19%; services 52%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the six months ended June 30, 2022 was: cloud subscriptions 21%; software license 4%; maintenance 19%; services 52%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $27.9 million and $55.4 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2022, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $52.7 million and $84.5 million, respectively.
